discovery.auth: AppId + AppKey (developer app registration), user token for seller calls

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). Tradera runs a self-service Developer Program (SOAP v3 / REST v4) with SearchService, PublicService and listing/ProImport services.

fields.name: app_id
fields.help: Application ID (integer) of an app registered in the Tradera Developer Center (self-service).

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: Application key (GUID) of that app. Read-only calls (search, items, categories) need only these two headers.

adapter.terms: Tradera API usage policy: read-only and advisory use by default; no automated bidding or sniping. Default 10,000 calls per 24 h per method. Prices in SEK.

get_listing.note: GET /v4/items/{itemId} with X-App-Id/X-App-Key (REST v4, beta). price is the Buy Now price (SEK, integer); auction state (maxBid, nextBid, totalBids, endDate), attributeValues, imageLinks and seller stay in raw.

not_offered.search_listings: GET /v4/search exists (query, categoryId, pageNumber, orderBy), but its SearchResult schema in the published OpenAPI (https://api.tradera.com/v4/swagger/v4/swagger.json) is an empty object and the REST search page documents no response fields, so results cannot be mapped from evidence.
not_offered.decode_vin: No VIN lookup in the Tradera API.
not_offered.get_valuation: No valuation endpoint in the Tradera API.
not_offered.list_dealers: No dealer directory endpoint in the Tradera API.
not_offered.me: User endpoints need X-User-Id/X-User-Token from the token login flow; this adapter uses application credentials only.

evidence: host api.tradera.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 1/1 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://api.tradera.com/v4/swagger/v4/swagger.json: 1/1 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
